title: Just playing around with Uranus Theft Auto Simulator
author: Emergency-Reply-5437
selftext: Well this is just some slop you might wanna see how it will evolve in the next weeks. UTA Uranus Theft Auto is just a parody game. You got OP Weapons and can do regular missions for Toni, like selling Cevapcici on Miranda. but you can also just go completely wild with a space ship or fight Godzilla like creatures. You are the invasor of Uranus System. Some Humans were turned into dogs, the Aliens on Uranus accidentally turned half the human population into dogs by accident. You need to free them and pet them. But you can also wipe out the whole planet. Get into classic racecars or just get a DKL Transportater or a brown UTS Transporter without doors. Build with Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Astra 6.2, Suno and TripoAI as WebGL for Smartphones. Running in an single html file. Planet size is 300km. You can discover Pokemon like weird animals and hunt them and trade them or race on a 21km long racetrack like the Nürburgring nordschleife. It is still in development and this is an early beta version runs on its 102. Revision.
